truncation.reason: T7 media is not on this machine. The candidate universe is the documentary set: ledger rows that name these defects, the c044/c009 paragraphs in docs/handoffs/HANDOFF_BLENDER_SHOWROOM_2026-10-19.md, docs/recipes/FACE_PRESERVING_CLOTHING_SWAP.md, and the MediaPipe sheets already on PR #381. scoring_method.named_rejection: 2 if fendi_quote is non-empty, else 1 if verified_cause is non-empty, else 0. A hypothesis note does not score.
scoring_method.timecode: 2 if frames is a non-empty list, else 1 if time_window is non-empty, else 0.
scoring_method.baseline: 2 if baseline_artifact is a repo path, else 1 if baseline_cited is non-empty, else 0.
scoring_method.output_asset: 1 if defect_output_asset_id or current_output_asset_id is non-empty, else 0.
scoring_method.category_explicit: 1 if category is segmentation, generation, or compositing, else 0.
scoring_method.total: Sum of the six criteria. Higher is a stronger documentary candidate, not a pixel score.
scoring_method.tie_break: Higher baseline score, then candidate id ascending.
scoring_method.confidence_from_margin: High if a runner-up exists and margin >= 3; Med if margin >= 1; Low if margin is 0 or there is no runner-up. Margin is winner total minus runner-up total.
scoring_method.evidence_ceiling: If named_rejection < 2, the scorecard says the Fendi quote is absent. Margin confidence is not proof of the defect.
